name: sweety-monorepo
description: SWEETY — Blood Glucose Tracker | Healthcare SaaS Web Application

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.prisma:generate: node -e "process.env.DATABASE_URL = process.env.DATABASE_URL || 'postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/sweety_db'; require('child_process').execSync('prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma', { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env });"
